impact_assessment.purpose: Enforce egress PII sanitization on the streaming surface (close B-24 F1).
identified_risks: PII leaked before a multi-word match completes (early release)
PII longer than holdback H split at the window boundary
raw token ids exposed re-opening the bypass
mitigations: capped holdback H=128 + alnum-run guard; re-sanitize on arrival; flush on terminal
re-detokenize via encoding_rs (UTF-8 safe); release only on char boundaries
emit sanitized text only, never raw tokens on the secured path
adversarial tests: multi-word PII split across pushes/boundaries
residual_risks: PII string longer than H split exactly at the cut (documented); ~H-char streaming latency
